interpretation_guards: A root witness proves zero-clearance geometric boundary reachability in the declared model domain, not clinical feasibility, load support or exact original tracking.
Raw-pose signed clearances explicitly preserve tracking and may differ from nearest free-joint witnesses.
A strictly negative continuous bound means always intersecting geometry with no zero-boundary root, not impossible contact. A strictly positive bound means always above plane.
A force sphere generally needs penetration to support force; no force or event is inferred here. STL, spheres and binary points remain separate.
